source.quote: For each create/update, show the target

input.prompt: Write a KB article "Resetting your password" in section 3001, English and German. German text: "Passwort zuruecksetzen ...".

expected: Shows target (section 3001, en-us) and a preview, waits, creates with zendesk_create_article, then previews and on confirmation creates the de translation. Reports ids and Help Center URLs.
